label: Minimum age for a post-paid transit check card
appliesTo: Check cards carrying the post-paid transport function
why: Post-paid transit extends credit, so the age floor sits in the Specialized Credit Finance Business Act decree rather than in a card company's policy. It is the one hard statutory number in an area otherwise governed by internal assessment.

history.source: Enforcement Decree of the Specialized Credit Finance Business Act
history.note: Widened to 12 by the amendment of this date. The amendment set the age floor — it did not create the credit character of post-paid transit, which is a common misreading.
